title: Onyx is joining Zoom: a letter to our customers
summary: Onyx is joining Zoom. Nothing about how you use Onyx is changing: same product, same team, same service. Read our letter to customers and the FAQ.
body_markdown:
## A Letter to our Customers


Today we’re announcing that Onyx is joining Zoom. We want to start with what matters most: **nothing about how you use Onyx is changing. Same product, same team, same service.** What follows is why we made this decision and what it opens up.


## What this means for you


-


Same product


Onyx remains a standalone, open-source


, app-agnostic


product.


-


Same team


The Onyx team, including customer success and forward deployed engineers, keeps working with you.


-


Same data access


If you self-host, nothing changes for your data. If we manage your deployment, no one at Zoom outside the Onyx team has access to your data.


-


Same subscription


Renewals and expansions go through the same channels, and there’s nothing you need to do.


Read the FAQ


When ChatGPT arrived, it was clear that large language models would change how work gets done. It was just as clear what they were missing. A model could tell you almost anything about the world, but nothing about your customers, your processes, the hard-won context that makes your team effective. It was a brilliant new hire, stuck on day one.


We started Onyx to close that gap.


Three years in, Onyx serves hundreds of thousands of people across hundreds of enterprises around the world. Some of those deployments run under extremely strict security requirements. Some operate at enormous scale. Some are heavily customized (made possible by OSS). Together, Onyx users send more than a million queries a week.


We got here because of you, our users and customers. Thank you for choosing Onyx, for pushing the product to new heights of polish and scale, and for inspiring us with visions of the future.


Joining Zoom lets us bring Onyx to an even wider audience. So much of an organization’s context lives in its meetings, calls, and chats, and we’re excited to make that context available in Onyx. We’re also excited to be providing this context to Zoom so that decisions can be actioned on by AI rather than sitting in transcripts. Our commitment hasn’t changed, though. Onyx remains app-agnostic, an unbiased connector for your organization’s knowledge wherever it lives. Zoom becomes one more source of context, not the only one. What’s new is what’s behind us: more resources to build faster and support you even better.


It remains our biggest honor to partner with you and to be trusted with your organization’s knowledge. We can’t wait to show you what’s next.


Chris Weaver and Yuhong Sun


Co-founders, Onyx
